article.content: Black Agenda Report October 16, 2026 Authors Black Agenda Radio with Margaret Kimberley bareditors Fri, 10/16/2026 - 21:46 Black Agenda Radio · Black Agenda Report October 16, 2026 In this week’s segment, we see through supposed disagreements between the US and Canada and recognize their partnership in settler colonialism, enslavement, and imperialism. But we begin with a discussion of the Democratic Republic of Congo, where elites jockey for power while colluding with imperialist forces that decimate the country.
